definitions.explanation: Physical or emotional distress. The noun form of the verb 苦しむ (to suffer). Covers a wide range from physical pain to deep emotional torment.

examples.japanese: {苦|くる}しみ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{逃|に}げたい→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to escape from the suffering.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{苦|くる}しみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えて→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧になった。
examples.english: After overcoming the suffering of a long illness, I finally got well.

notes:
USAGE:
{苦|くる}しみ is the nominal form of ⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧ (to suffer). It conveys deeper, more prolonged distress than ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧ (pain), which is primarily physical. {苦|くる}しみ encompasses both physical and emotional suffering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {苦|くる}しみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{味|あじ}わう→味わう：04405_ajiwau⟧: to experience suffering
- {苦|くる}しみ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧: to endure suffering
- {苦|くる}しみ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{逃|に}れる: to escape from suffering
- {苦|くる}しみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}える→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧: to overcome suffering
- {苦|くる}しみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}かち{合|あ}う→分かち合う：18203_wakachiau⟧: to share suffering
